items.prompt: An old library card catalogue in a dark reading room: rows of small wooden drawers, one drawer pulled out and lit from above, its index cards fanned, everything else in shadow.

alt.ru: Старый библиотечный каталог в тёмном зале: ряды деревянных ящичков, один выдвинут и освещён, карточки в нём веером.
alt.en: An old library card catalogue in a dark reading room: rows of wooden drawers, one pulled out and lit, its cards fanned.
alt.pt: Um velho ficheiro de biblioteca numa sala escura: filas de gavetas de madeira, uma puxada e iluminada, as fichas em leque.
alt.es: Un viejo fichero de biblioteca en una sala oscura: filas de cajones de madera, uno abierto e iluminado, sus fichas en abanico.
